requirements.quote: RF-03 | A tender comprises the completed technical specification, the technical tender, the financial offer model, the data summary sheet in Appendix A and a security self-assessment | S15 §2.16.3, §2.16.10
requirements.text: The tender must include the technical specification, technical tender, financial offer, data summary sheet, and security self-assessment.

requirements.quote: RF-04 | Questions go in writing through the Owner's portal by the stated deadline, and answers are published anonymously to all bidders | S15 §2.8
requirements.text: Questions must be submitted in writing via the Owner's portal by the deadline, and answers will be shared anonymously.

requirements.quote: RF-05 | Bidders shall use a single point of contact, and soliciting information from anyone else can lead to exclusion | S15 §2.4
requirements.text: Bidders must use a single point of contact; contacting others may result in exclusion.

requirements.quote: RF-06 | The procedure is a competitive dialogue in three steps: qualification, dialogue with at least two sessions per candidate and one mandatory site visit, and final tender. Up to three candidates advance, and only invited candidates may submit a final tender | S15 §2.1, §2.14.6, §2.15
requirements.text: The process includes qualification, dialogue sessions, a site visit, and a final tender; only invited candidates may submit the final tender.

requirements.quote: Appendix A: Data summary sheet Every tender includes this sheet, completed in total and per partition. The fields mirror the summary sheets used in S14 and S15.
requirements.text: The tender must include a completed data summary sheet, reflecting fields from S14 and S15.

requirements.quote: Compute | Number of nodes, in total and by type | count | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Provide the total number of nodes and their types.

requirements.quote: Compute | Peak performance, in total and per partition | PFlop/s | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Specify the peak performance in total and per partition.

requirements.quote: Compute | Memory bandwidth and byte-addressable capacity, in total and per node type | TiB/s; TB | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Detail memory bandwidth and byte-addressable capacity, total and per node type.

requirements.quote: Compute | Accelerator and processor types | text | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: List the types of accelerators and processors.

requirements.quote: Compute | Network type, topology, latency and bisection bandwidth | text; µs; Tb/s | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Provide details on network type, topology, latency, and bisection bandwidth.

requirements.quote: Storage | Bandwidth, IOPS and usable capacity per tier | GB/s; IOPS; GB | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Specify storage bandwidth, IOPS, and usable capacity per tier.

requirements.quote: Site | Total floor size including service area | m² | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Indicate the total floor size, including service area.

requirements.quote: Site | Maximum power under any workload, in total and per partition | kW | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Provide the maximum power under any workload, total and per partition.

requirements.quote: Site | Number of racks, rack TDP and maximum weight per rack | count; kW; t/m² | S15 Annex 10C; S6
requirements.text: Detail the number of racks, rack TDP, and maximum weight per rack.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Rated DC output of each power block | MW | L2.02
requirements.text: Specify the rated DC output of each power block.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Efficiency at 50% and 100% load | % | S2 §4.3
requirements.text: Provide efficiency at 50% and 100% load.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Output regulation, static and dynamic, and ripple | % | S2 §4.3
requirements.text: Detail output regulation, static and dynamic, and ripple.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Short-circuit rating | kA for 1 s | S14
requirements.text: Specify the short-circuit rating.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Breaker clearing time and the holdup that covers it | ms | S5
requirements.text: Provide breaker clearing time and holdup duration.

requirements.quote: Power chain | Ingress protection and lead time delivered duty paid | IP rating; weeks | S14
requirements.text: Specify ingress protection and lead time delivered duty paid.

requirements.quote: Cooling | CDU rated capacity and secondary flow | kW; L/min | S14
requirements.text: Provide CDU rated capacity and secondary flow.

requirements.quote: Cooling | Primary and secondary supply and return temperatures | °C | S14
requirements.text: Specify primary and secondary supply and return temperatures.

requirements.quote: Cooling | Maximum water inlet and expected outlet temperatures | °C | S15 Annex 10C
requirements.text: Provide maximum water inlet and expected outlet temperatures.

requirements.text: Specify the liquid-captured fraction of rack heat.
